adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Calendar.createEvent` to accept `(event, credentialId)` and updates Google to select the destination calendar matching that `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`). However, `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` still has `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and now explicitly uses only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then builds `/me/calendars/${mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId}/events`). Separately, `handleNewBooking.ts` appends additional collective hosts’ destination calendars to `evt.destinationCalendar` (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`), and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` fans out over `event.destinationCalendar`, calling `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` for each destination. Since Office365 ignores `credentialId` (and any per-destination selection) and always uses the first destination calendar, collective host credentials can POST to the main host’s calendar externalId, hitting the wrong calendar or failing.
